title: नेता कार्यकर्तालाई ओलीको चेतावनी- पार्टीभित्रका कुरा फेसबुकमा लेखे अब क्षमा दिइँदैन (भिडिओ)
content:
No ads found for this position काठमाडौं । नेकपा एमालेका अध्यक्ष केपी ओलीले पार्टीभित्रको कुरा सामाजिक सञ्जालमा लेख्ने नेता कार्यकर्तालाई कारबाही गर्ने चेतावनी दिएका छन्। राष्ट्रिय भेलालाई सम्बोधन गर्दै महाधिवेशनले गरेको निर्णयलाई लिएर पटकपटक एउटै कुरा गरिरहे स्वीकार्य नहुने चेतावनी दिए। उनले भने, ‘महाधिवेशनमा हामी थियौँ होइन र? केही साथीले चित्त नबुझेर विपक्षमा भोट हाल्या होइन ? महाधिवेशनको निर्णय सर्लक्क मानेर अर्को महाधिवेशनसम्म जानु परेन? अनि बिचमा जहिले पनि त्यही एकतारे बजाएर र्‍याइँ–र्‍याइँ गरिरहने?’ पार्टीभित्रको आन्तरिक केही विषयमा चित्त नबुझेको कमिटीमा राख्न पाइने बताए। उनले थपे, ‘कमिटीमा राख्नै पाइएन भन्ने नक्कली गुनासो नगरौँ। कमिटीमा राख्दा कसैले कसैको मुख थुनेको छैन। कसैले आक्रमण गरेकाे पनि छैन, कसैले केही गरेको पनि छैन। नक्कली कुरा नगरौँ।’ पार्टीभित्र छलफलको विषय फेसबुकमा लेखेर विरोधीलाई मौका दिने गतिविधि स्वीकार्य नहुने बताए। ओलीले भने, ‘हामीले अस्तिको केन्द्रीय कमिटीलाई कटअफ बैठक भनेका छौँ। त्यसभन्दा अगाडि जसले अनुशासनहीन काम गरेको भएता पनि, सामाजिक सञ्जालमा गएको भएता पनि, फेसबुक रङ्गाएको भएता पनि, अनुशासन तोडेको भएता पनि अस्तिको केन्द्रीय कमिटी बैठकको मितिभन्दा अगाडिका कुराहरूलाई क्षमा गरिएको छ। अब त्यही कुरा दोहोरिए स्वीकार्य हुँदैन।’ आफूलाई पक्राउ गर्नुअघि पार्टीकै एक नेताले अन्तर्वार्तामा ओलीलाई पक्राउ गरेर एमाले सडकमा जाँदैन भनेर बोलेको भन्दै आक्रोश पोखे। ‘के भनेको त्यो एमाले हुँ भन्ने मान्छेले? आफू नउत्रिनु नि, उत्रिँदैन त्यो ठिकै छ। आफू नउत्रिनु नि! कार्यकर्ता नै उत्रिँदैनन् भन्ने, उत्रिए त देशैभरि’ उनले थपे, ‘ती व्यक्तिलाई केपी ओलीलाई गिरफ्तार गर्दै छ भन्ने थाहा छ? सरकार हच्किराखेको छ। सरकारलाई ढाडस दिने ? केही पनि हुँदैन, एक जना मान्छे पनि सडकमा उत्रिँदैन भनेको समात भनेको त हो नि।’ Kathmandu. CPN-UML Chairman KP Oli has warned of action against leaders and cadres who post internal party matters on social media. Addressing the national gathering, he warned that repeating the same thing over and over again regarding the decisions taken by the general convention will not be acceptable. He said, 'Weren't we at the general convention? Didn't some friends vote against it out of dissatisfaction? Didn't we have to accept the decision of the general convention and go to the next general convention? And in between, they always play the same tune and keep on arguing?' He said that those who are dissatisfied with some internal issues within the party can be placed in a committee. He added, "Let's not make false complaints about not being included in the committee. No one has silenced anyone while being included in the committee. No one has attacked anyone, no one has done anything. Let's not make false claims." He said that giving an opportunity to the opposition by posting topics of discussion within the party on Facebook is unacceptable. Oli said, "We have called the previous Central Committee meeting a cutoff meeting. Even if anyone has acted undisciplined before that, whether they have gone on social media, posted on Facebook, or broken discipline, the things that happened before the date of the previous Central Committee meeting have been forgiven. Now, if the same thing is repeated, it will not be acceptable." Before his arrest, a party leader expressed anger in an interview by saying that the UML would not go on the streets after Oli was arrested. 'What did that person who says he is UML mean? He doesn't come out, he won't come out, that's fine. He doesn't come out! He says that even the cadres won't come out, if they come out, the whole country will,' he added, 'Does that person know that KP Oli is being arrested? The government is hesitating. Will he reassure the government? Nothing will happen, not even a single person will come out on the streets, that's what arrest means, right?'

Kathmandu. CPN-UML Chairman KP Oli has warned of action against leaders and cadres who post internal party matters on social media. Addressing the national gathering, he warned that repeating the same thing over and over again regarding the decisions taken by the general convention will not be acceptable.

He said, 'Weren't we at the general convention? Didn't some friends vote against it out of dissatisfaction? Didn't we have to accept the decision of the general convention and go to the next general convention? And in between, they always play the same tune and keep on arguing?'

He said that those who are dissatisfied with some internal issues within the party can be placed in a committee.

He added, "Let's not make false complaints about not being included in the committee. No one has silenced anyone while being included in the committee. No one has attacked anyone, no one has done anything. Let's not make false claims."

He said that giving an opportunity to the opposition by posting topics of discussion within the party on Facebook is unacceptable.

Oli said, "We have called the previous Central Committee meeting a cutoff meeting. Even if anyone has acted undisciplined before that, whether they have gone on social media, posted on Facebook, or broken discipline, the things that happened before the date of the previous Central Committee meeting have been forgiven.
